turn.question: Draft the award memo for the VP.
turn.answer: The award memo for the VP has been drafted and saved as `Award_Memo_RFX-2026-PKG-017.docx`. It outlines the recommendation to proceed with Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders based on their compliance with our quality requirements, while also highlighting the need to verify Ganesh Kraft Traders' pricing before finalization.

sections.body: The RFx process for corrugated packaging (RFX-2026-PKG-017) has concluded. Following a comprehensive review of vendor submissions and quality compliance, we recommend awarding the contract to Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. and Ganesh Kraft Traders. These vendors were the only participants to pass the mandatory quality questionnaire, which included requirements for in-house ECT/BCT testing and valid ISO 9001 certification.
sections.heading: Executive Summary

sections.body: We performed a least-cost per-line analysis to determine the optimal allocation of business between the two qualified vendors. Based on current pricing, Vardhan Packaging Works Pvt. Ltd. is assigned 28 lines, and Ganesh Kraft Traders is assigned 2 lines. This allocation is based on ex-tax and ex-freight unit prices. No vendors provided freight costs; therefore, a landed comparison was not possible.
sections.heading: Award Strategy

sections.body: The proposed award to Ganesh Kraft Traders depends on 30 unconfirmed price values. All of their submitted quotes are flagged with medium confidence and have open review items, as they were extracted from a rate card image. We strongly recommend completing a thorough verification of these prices before finalizing any contractual agreements. Furthermore, any attempt to cap individual vendor share at 40% resulted in an infeasible scenario under current conditions.
sections.heading: Risk and Mitigation
